name: EDCI 5742
title: Sheltered English Instruction for English Language Learners
description: Current approaches and techniques with respect to academic language development in sheltered environments.  This course attempts to disclose the most important issues surrounding content area teaching for English Language Learners (ELLs).  Special attention is placed on the teaching of mathematics, science, and literacy in English for second language learners, including second language acquisition and development within the content areas.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
